_about: Prop drawing styles (references/treatment.md section 4). prompt = <subject> + ' ' + suffix + ' ' + tail. Pick ONE style per episode; set it in project.json "prop_look". sample: templates/prop_styles/<id>.png, pass it as a reference image to keep every prop of the episode in the same style. shadow: how els8 propShadow places it on the page. dark / light: usable on dark plates / on paper pages. luma: run scripts/prop_prep.py --luma (the model returns a dark fill inside the silhouette). themes: first = the theme it was verified in.
tail: Single isolated subject, centered, the whole subject visible with a small margin, no text, no letters, no logos, no background, no ground, no cast shadow.

test_subjects.a: A cheerful anthropomorphic coffee bean character with a simple happy face, small arms and legs, waving one hand, standing, full body.
test_subjects.b: A cargo ship loaded with stacked shipping containers, side view, bow pointing right.

styles.topics: 商业、消费、财经通用；她原片图标的画法
styles.suffix: Cute 2.5D cartoon sticker illustration: soft gradient shading, gentle highlights, thin dark-brown outlines, rounded chunky shapes, warm saturated colors.

styles.topics: 农业、手工业、节日、地方文化
styles.suffix: Layered paper-cut craft illustration: shapes cut from matte colored cardstock in 4 to 6 stacked layers, visible paper thickness and soft shadows between the layers, slightly rough hand-cut edges, warm muted palette of mustard, teal, brick red and cream.

styles.topics: 教育、科普、经济学原理、算账
styles.suffix: Hand-drawn chalk drawing as if on a blackboard: dusty strokes of white, pale yellow, pink and mint chalk, visible chalk grain and smudges, sketchy outlines with simple hatching fills. Only the chalk marks, no blackboard.

styles.topics: 生活消费、食品、玩具、儿童
styles.suffix: Handmade claymation figure made of plasticine: visible fingerprints and sculpting tool marks, soft rounded forms, matte surface, saturated playful colors, photographed under soft studio light.

styles.topics: 互联网产品、App、新消费品牌
styles.suffix: Glossy 3D render like a designer vinyl toy or a premium 3D app icon: smooth rounded forms, soft studio lighting with gentle rim light, subtle reflections, saturated candy colors, Blender-quality render.

styles.topics: 品牌史、广告营销、老字号、美国消费史
styles.suffix: 1950s mid-century advertising illustration: flat gouache shapes with soft dry-brush texture, limited retro palette of teal, mustard, coral and cream, cheerful vintage character design, slightly offset print look.

styles.topics: 文化、独立品牌、潮流、年轻人
styles.suffix: Risograph print illustration: two or three soy inks (fluorescent pink, medium blue, yellow) with grainy texture, slight misregistration between the colors, overprinted color mixing, flat simple shapes.

styles.topics: 宏观、政策、社会议题
styles.note: the model drifts to a brown sticker look unless the three colours are forced; say which part is cobalt blue
styles.suffix: Flat vector editorial illustration in the style of a modern New Yorker or Monocle spot illustration: strictly three flat colors only - cobalt blue, tomato red and warm off-white - plus solid black; no gradients, no shading, no highlights, no outlines around every shape, simplified geometric shapes, confident and graphic.

styles.topics: 设计、观念、心理、极简话题
styles.note: thin drawing: show it at w >= 420
styles.suffix: Minimal continuous single-line drawing in black ink with one flat cobalt-blue accent shape offset behind part of it, elegant and simple, generous negative space.

styles.topics: 娱乐、争议事件、反转、八卦
styles.suffix: Pop-art comic illustration: thick black ink outlines, bold primary colors, Ben-Day halftone dot shading, Lichtenstein style, with a thick white sticker border around the silhouette.

styles.topics: 具体商品、价格拆解、开箱、成本
styles.note: phrase the subject as a physical object: 'a handmade painted wooden figurine of ...', 'a detailed scale model of ...'
styles.suffix: Studio product photograph of a real physical object: true materials such as painted wood, ceramic, metal and paper, soft top light, crisp focus, natural colors, cleanly cut out.

styles.topics: 旅行、地理、自然、农产品产地
styles.suffix: Loose watercolor illustration over a light pencil underdrawing: soft wet washes, pigment blooms and granulation, gentle natural palette, hand-painted feel, soft irregular painted edges.

styles.topics: 历史、金融史、老新闻、人物传记
styles.suffix: Vintage newspaper engraving illustration: black ink cross-hatching and fine line shading, 19th-century print look, monochrome, printed on a piece of off-white newsprint cut out with a thin irregular paper margin following the silhouette.

styles.topics: 劳工、工业史、强烈的社会议题
styles.suffix: Bold linocut woodcut print: carved black ink shapes with visible gouge marks, one vermilion red spot color, rough ink texture, printed on a piece of cream paper cut out with a thin irregular margin following the silhouette.

styles.topics: 中国历史、传统文化、茶、酒、瓷器
styles.suffix: Traditional Chinese ink wash painting: expressive brush strokes, graded black ink washes, a small touch of vermilion, painted on a piece of xuan rice paper cut out with a soft deckled edge following the silhouette.

styles.topics: 新闻事件、媒体、多方说法、舆论
styles.suffix: Cut-and-paste collage: the subject assembled from torn vintage magazine photos, newsprint and colored paper scraps, visible torn white paper edges and a small piece of masking tape, zine aesthetic.

styles.topics: 工程、制造、基础设施、芯片
styles.note: on paper pages use tint='#1f3f7a' (blue ink); in terminal use tint='#33ff88'
styles.suffix: Technical line drawing in thin white strokes like an engineering blueprint sketch: isometric view, faint construction lines and small dimension ticks, no fill, white lines only.

styles.topics: 拆解结构、产业链内部、机器原理
styles.suffix: Technical cutaway illustration: precise clean line work, one section cut open to reveal the inner parts, flat engineering colors of orange, light blue and grey, like a technical manual diagram, no labels, no callouts.

styles.topics: 夜经济、赌场、娱乐业、赛博、加密货币
styles.suffix: Neon sign made of glowing bent glass tubes: bright tube lines in hot pink, cyan and amber with a soft glow, outline shapes only.

styles.topics: 游戏、互联网早期、程序员、复古科技
styles.suffix: 16-bit pixel art sprite: crisp square pixels, one-pixel dark outline, limited 16-color palette, SNES-era game look, no anti-aliasing.
